en.t: Yes, the Master is also playing very steadily.

units.source_text: 一方稳扎稳打，一方不稳健，就必然凌乱，处于被动。

en.t: When one side plays steadily and the other does not, the game is bound to become disorderly, leaving that side on the defensive.

units.source_text: 时间十分充裕，又是非常重要的一盘棋。”

en.t: There is plenty of time, and this is also an extremely important game.”
